name: Russian Studies
notes: Five courses. This is the interdisciplinary Russian Studies minor, distinct from the Russian language minor (minor-russ) and from the Russian Studies MAJOR (major-rust-ba).

DIVISION IS YOUR CHOICE: 'The Russian studies major and minor can be counted in either humanities or social sciences, depending on your choice of courses (to count as social science, the majority of courses must be taken in history, international relations and political science).' Filed here under humanities.

COURSE LISTS ARE IN AN UNCAPTURED PDF - NEEDS VERIFICATION: the page names the categories but points to a 'complete list of Russian courses' PDF for the courses themselves. The history and political-science groups therefore accept any HIST or PSCI course; check every choice against the department list or with a Russian advisor.
